say:1:1035729001:0.text: Haven't seen a golem out here in a while. So much for that...
say:1:1035729001:0.source_cn: 没有好生意了。好久没有魔偶出来了……

say:2:1035729002:1.text: The Hypofiends out there don't make it easy to sell this junk, either.
say:2:1035729002:1.source_cn: 外面的魔物不太好对付，收购渠道也没有了。

say:3:1035729003:1.text: So remember to give me a holler if you find a better way to make coin!
say:3:1035729003:1.source_cn: 要是有遇到好的生意，记得通知兄弟一声啊！
say:3:1035729003:1.male: So remember to give me a holler if you find a better way to make coin!
say:3:1035729003:1.female: So remember to give me a holler if you find a better way to make coin!
